subject: general
question: With which of the following Indian classical dance forms was T Balasaraswati associated ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Tanjore Balasaraswati also known as Balasaraswati was an Indian dancer, and her rendering of Bharatanatyam, a classical dance style that originated in the South Indian state of Tamil Nadu, made this style of dancing well known in different parts of India and many parts of the world.
 
• She was awarded the Padma Bhushan in 1957 and the Padma Vibhushan in 1977, the third and the second highest civilian honors given by the Government of India.
 
• She received numerous awards in India, including the President's Award from the Sangeet Natak Akademi and Sangita Kalanidhi from the Madras Music Academy, South India's highest award for musicians.
 
• India Today based on a survey, classified her as one of the 100 prominent Indians who have shaped the destiny of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bharatanatyam is a major form of Indian classical dance that originated in Tamil Nadu. 
 
• Kuchipudi is one of the eight major Indian classical dances. It originates from a village named Kuchipudi in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh. 
 
• Kathakali or 'story play' took shape in Kerala in southern India in the seventeenth century under the patronage of the prince of Karnataka.
 
• The Manipuri Dance, also referred to as the Manipuri Raas Leela, is one of the eight major Indian classical dance forms, originating from the state of Manipur.
